# Migration corpus expectations.
#
# <file> <expected --strict exit> <unsupported directives, comma separated or ->
#
# `--strict` is fail-closed on any warning (EXY-IMPORT-0003), so a realistic
# config with warnings must exit 1. Each unsupported directive is listed with
# its reason in docs/architecture/078-migration-corpus.md; a new warning or a
# new corpus file without an entry fails the gate.
